example_sentences_in_bangla: এই চাকরিটি মেঘের ছায়ার মতো অস্থায়ী।
তার সাহায্য মেঘের ছায়া, কোনো নির্ভরযোগ্যতা নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: This job is like the shade of a cloud—temporary and unreliable.
His support is merely the shade of a cloud, offering no real security.
history: Derived from observations of fleeting natural phenomena in Bengali folklore, emphasizing impermanence.
note: The idiom highlights the transience of cloud shadows, often used metaphorically for unstable situations.
